fields.description: The defaults Vorgaben laden or Vorgaben aktualisieren took over last: the chart, the edition of the DATEV chart and the revision of the defaults of Steuerbote.
fields.label: Defaults Version

fields.description: The rows the defaults gave this mapping when they were taken over last, against which Vorgaben aktualisieren tells the changes of the defaults from your own.
fields.label: Defaults as Taken Over

fields.description: Which account feeds which Kennzahl. The amount is the balance of the period on the given side.
fields.label: Account Rules

fields.description: Verprobung: the tax booked on the tax accounts against the tax on the base accounts, voucher by voucher.
fields.label: Tax Checks

fields.description: For the vouchers that book the tax of § 13b UStG without a base account, Steuerbote takes Kz 46 for a supplier established in another member state and Kz 84 for every other, by the country of the supplier. A row here decides instead, for the exceptions: for one voucher, for a supplier or for a tax template; a voucher row wins over a supplier row, a supplier row over a template row.
fields.label: Classifications under § 13b UStG

fields.description: Accounts of the Voranmeldung without a Kennzahl yet. A balance on one watched at the level Blocking holds the return; on one watched at the level Hint, it adds a hint to the return.
fields.label: Watched Accounts

fields.description: Accounts whose balance no Kennzahl of the Voranmeldung takes and only the annual return reads, such as the Erwerb des ersten Abnehmers in an innergemeinschaftliches Dreiecksgeschäft for Kz 789: the balance of the year on the given side goes into the field.
fields.label: Rules for the Annual Return Only
